title: monogate-automation-intervention-ledger.v1
description: One file per session. Append-only: entries and findings only ever grow. See PROTOCOL.md E1 for what each kind and class MEANS -- the definitions are the measurement, not documentation of it. AMENDMENT 1 (2026-07-30): entries carry `actor`. The claim under test is about the HUMAN outer loop; a ledger that records that taste HAPPENED without recording WHO exercised it would let AI self-catches confirm the hypothesis for the wrong reason. `actor` is not required by the schema so that pre-amendment entries stay valid and append-only holds; the CLI requires it and the gate flags its absence on new entries.

boundary.description: The `?` flag. TRUE means the kind was a judgement call. Boundary cases are LOGGED AND FLAGGED, never dropped -- a dropped boundary case is a silent thumb on the scale.

actor.description: WHO performed the intervention. Added by AMENDMENT 1 (2026-07-30). Absent on entries logged before the amendment -- those are 'unrecorded', which the report keeps in its OWN bucket rather than folding into any actor, because an unrecorded actor and a known actor are different facts. Required on all new entries.

artifact_link.description: REQUIRED. House rule 6: no claim without an artifact. A finding with nowhere to point is not yet a finding.
